summary: The EduPreEmployment document is a user control designed to handle the educational pre-employment processes for staff within the HSPnet system. It offers various functionalities including adding, editing, and deleting educational records, managing user sessions, and ensuring data validation.
purpose: The purpose of the EduPreEmployment user control is to facilitate the management and operation of educational pre-employment details for staff members within the HSPnet platform.
